name: exercise-ball-lateral-raise.html
instructions:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells with a neutral grip and sit on the center of an exercise ball with your feet around shoulder width apart.
2. Inhale, engage your core, and slowly raise the dumbbells to around shoulder height.
3. Pause, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
4. Repeat for desired reps.
